gozapp.autocomplete.enabled.description: Use native Copilot autocomplete with the selected provider for bounded inline suggestions. May incur provider API charges. No fallback to Copilot requests; native next-edit suggestions are disabled while enabled.

gozapp.autocomplete.model.description: Model ID selected using Gozapp: Configure AI Autocomplete Model. No automatic fallback to another provider.

gozapp.autocomplete.delay.description: Typing idle delay before an autocomplete request, in milliseconds (at least 2 seconds). Typing restarts the idle wait; existing matching suggestions are reused without a new request.
